info.title: Constant Contact Universal API
info.description: Create campaigns, grow contact lists, automate messages, and track marketing results.

post.description: Creates a contact in Constant Contact.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

email.description: Primary email address for the contact (must be unique in Constant Contact).

permissionToSend.description: Permission level for sending email to this contact.

createSource.description: Who created the contact (required for compliance).

listMemberships[].description: Optional. Array of list IDs. Do not pass objects; each item must be a list_id string.

emailAddress.description: Email address subresource for the contact.

listMemberships.description: List IDs the contact belongs to when provided.

metadata.description: Display and validation metadata object for the custom field.

choices[].description: Choices array for single_select or multi_select field types.

version.description: Datetime version for date fields (1 legacy string, 2 native date).
